title: Radio exception or cancellation can retry indeterminate on-air bytes with same replay tuple
description: Post-fix correctness review: once radio.transmit is invoked, exception/cancellation preserves identical signed bytes for later drain. Hardware may already have transmitted before the exception, causing duplicate same-tuple delivery and ambiguous caller failure. Treat any post-invocation indeterminate failure as terminal removal/failure of the exact entry; explicit retry uses fresh tuple. Test before/after hardware acceptance.
